WITH step_groups AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, COUNT(DISTINCT model) AS model_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stack_rows
    FROM main.model_score
    WHERE step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
)
SELECT step, COUNT(*) AS groups_total, MIN(stack_rows), MAX(stack_rows),
       MIN(model_count), MAX(model_count),
       SUM(name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM main.solution)) AS missing_solution
FROM step_groups
GROUP BY step

WITH step_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS best_non_stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS stack_score
    FROM main.model_score
    WHERE step IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
winning_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS winning_occurrences
    FROM step_scores
    WHERE best_non_stack_score < stack_score
    GROUP BY name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS solution_occurrences
    FROM main.solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT w.name, w.winning_occurrences, s.solution_occurrences
FROM winning_counts AS w
JOIN solution_counts AS s ON s.name = w.name
WHERE w.winning_occurrences > s.solution_occurrences
ORDER BY w.name
